source_title: House of the Dragon — Season 1 Episode 1 opening witness
continuity_scope: HBO television continuity only, restricted to the official HBO/Warner Bros. Discovery Pressroom synopsis for House of the Dragon Season 1, Episode 1, “The Heirs of the Dragon.” The bounded witness comprises Viserys hosting a tournament to celebrate the birth of his second child and Rhaenyra welcoming her uncle Daemon back to the Red Keep. Fire & Blood, Game of Thrones, later House of the Dragon episodes/seasons, related histories, games, and all non-television continuities are excluded.
work_or_witnesses: House of the Dragon, HBO television series, Season 1 Episode 1: “The Heirs of the Dragon”
HBO/Warner Bros. Discovery Pressroom official episode synopsis
coverage_rule: Include every named individual dramatic character in the selected official episode-one synopsis: Viserys, Rhaenyra, and Daemon. The unnamed second child and every other person are omitted. The Red Keep, tournament, childbirth reference, titles, houses, dragons, succession rules, institutions, artifacts, places, and political roles are terms/context rather than character nodes unless a named individual is directly supplied by the witness.
omissions: Every named individual absent from the selected official synopsis, including the unnamed second child and all later Episode 1 or later-season figures.
All Fire & Blood material, Game of Thrones material, other A Song of Ice and Fire histories, games, adaptations, marketing continuities, and later House of the Dragon episodes/seasons.
Titles, houses, dragons, succession law, institutions, artifacts, political offices, places beyond the directly named Red Keep setting, and any unverified cast/credit inference as character data.

Exact ages, youth status, gender identity, ancestry/ethnicity, disability, medical details, cause or outcome of childbirth, death, violence, marital status, sexual/romantic conduct, dynastic policy, and historical analogies, none of which are established by the selected synopsis.
Fan wikis, Wikipedia, databases, recaps, social posts, and unlicensed transcripts.
uncertainties: The source says Viserys celebrates the birth of his second child but does not name the child, identify a birthing parent, state medical circumstances, or describe any outcome. No childbirth, death, or family relationship beyond the source wording is inferred.

The source explicitly calls Daemon Rhaenyra's uncle. It supplies no romantic, sexual, marital, or dynastic-marriage claim; the kinship is retained without applying an incest label or importing later events.

The source supplies no numerical ages, age category, gender-identity claim, disability claim, violence detail, succession-law explanation, title, house affiliation, dragon association, or historical analogy.

The HBO release says the series is based on Fire & Blood and set before Game of Thrones, but that production context is used only to mark excluded adjacent continuities, never to import their plot or character facts.
evidence_basis: Official HBO/Warner Bros. Discovery Pressroom materials only. The episode-one synopsis supplies all included character, kinship, return, tournament, birth-reference, and Red Keep claims. An official HBO release is used solely to document the excluded source-adjacent book/Game of Thrones context.
